_doc: TANG 1 — KHUNG HOI THOAI + PHIEN MUA dung chung moi nganh (chep tu Sales Desk dialogue_frame.js 28/08 va episode_tracker.js 30/08/2026). Bieu thuc chinh quy chay tren chu DA BO DAU (normalize), tru `ack`/`deny` chay tren chu goc (co dau, khong phan biet hoa thuong). Mau dinh nganh (hoi size, hoi muc dich, ma san pham, tu nhieu trong ten mau) nam o nganh/<id>/khung-hoi-thoai.json va duoc GHEP THEM vao day. Sua tep nay = doi cach doc tin ngan cua ca nen tang.
